## Claim & Evidence

**Claim:** 隔火焚香 (gé huǒ fén xiāng, "incense across fire") — the classical method of heating incense without burning it: a hot charcoal buried in ash, with a thin plate (silver leaf or mica) on top carrying the material, which warms but does not combust.
